title: Apply for a tow truck operator licence
summary: Learn about the requirements and steps to apply for a tow truck operator licence in NSW.
intro:
To operate a tow truck business you must hold an operator licence. You can apply for your operator licence by lodging an application online with NSW Fair Trading.

There are 3 different types of work, and each requires a different licence:

Note: You do not need a tow truck operator licence if you are towing, salvaging or storing exempted vehicles or trailers.
who_can_apply: Must already hold a tow truck drivers certificate.
If not holding a current tow truck drivers certificate, must provide details of at least one certified nominated driver.
what_you_need: Documents must be no older than 6 weeks.
A copy of photo ID (front and back) or passport for all authorised persons.
National Police Check Certificates for all authorised persons.
If officers lived overseas within 10 years: National Police Certificates must be in English, or a translated version via Multicultural NSW.
Certificate of currency for public liability insurance for the nominated place of business (all business types).
Certificate of currency for on hook insurance for each vehicle, or a completed exemption form.
A copy of current vehicle registration papers, or on hold receipts/lease for non-owned tow trucks.
Certificate of currency for public liability insurance for the holding yard(s).
Proof of ownership of the holding yard(s).
For Company (Pty Ltd): Certificate of incorporation AND Latest annual company statement/extract.
For Sole Trader: Certificate Registration of Business Name.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a licence.
Download and complete the form Application for a tow truck operator licence – PDF.
Submit your application with payment to towtrucks@customerservice.nsw.gov.au

more_info.text: If your application is approved you will be sent your licence.
If your application is refused, you'll be notified in writing. You can apply for a review if you disagree with the decision.

faqs.q: Do I need a tow truck operator licence?
faqs.a: You must hold an operator licence to operate a tow truck business. However, you do not need a licence if you are towing, salvaging or storing exempted vehicles or trailers.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility requirement to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You must already hold a tow truck drivers certificate. If you do not have a current certificate, you must provide details for at least one certified nominated driver.

faqs.q: What documents are needed for the application?
faqs.a: Required documents include photo ID for all authorised persons, National Police Check Certificates, and proof of insurance and business details depending on your business structure.

faqs.q: Where can I find a list of exempt vehicles?
faqs.a: A list of exempt vehicles is available on the NSW Fair Trading website.
